scenario: Insert a 100000-line scalar program with Playwright keyboard.insertText, then edit its last expression
observation: The native insertText command did not return within the observation window and the browser test was stopped. No completed latency can be reported for this historical run. The 13.49 ms core incremental benchmark must not be presented as editor end-to-end latency.
correction: This historical scenario was previously mislabeled as clipboard paste. Follow-up profiling distinguished Chromium native insertText DOM expansion from CodeMirror real Ctrl+V clipboard transactions. Real clipboard baseline returned in 96 ms. See large-document-root-cause.json.
followUp: The subsequent implementation and current browser verification are documented in ../FEATURES_2026-10-24.md and features-validation/. This historical incomplete result is preserved, not presented as the current version.
